notes:
### Added

- **Queue survives reloads:** the message queue above the composer is now persisted by the app and restored after a window reload, so messages typed while a turn is running are never lost.
- **Context card in the transcript:** each turn shows an 8-block context breakdown (system, tools, memory, history, attachments…) rendered with the same visual language as tool rows, instead of a raw token number.
- **Cache-aware context layout:** prompts are assembled cache-first, keeping stable prefix blocks (system, tool definitions) ahead of per-turn content — reported to cut provider cache misses on the second request from ~96% invalidation to ~4%.
- **Image lightbox:** clicking an attached image in the transcript opens a full-size viewer with zoom instead of a tiny inline thumb.

### Changed

- **Tool rows follow the ZCode skin:** tool call rows (labels, group headers, icons, collapse behavior) now match the ZCode desktop look, superseding the older tool-card icon layout.
- **Search and glob respect ignore rules:** file search and glob skip `.gitignore`d paths by default (opt-in to include them) and resolve patterns relative to the searched directory; truncated results hint at how to narrow them.

### Fixed

- **Tool status survives reload:** a tool call that was denied or errored no longer renders as success after reloading the window.
- **Workbench navigation polish:** the Files view is derived from the workbench store (no stale tabs), closing a tab from the view strip stays on the same strip, and doc-only strips no longer hide their tab.
- **Blank chats keep their id:** a new chat created in the frontend now uses its own stable id (idempotent create, orphaned ids are swept after 7 days) instead of being re-id'd on first send.
- **A tool timeout no longer kills the whole turn:** when a tool exceeds its deadline the remaining tools in the batch are skipped but the turn continues and reports what happened.
- **Compaction hardening:** checkpoint gate, lock ordering and the model budget in compact are fixed; compacted conversations keep their pending queue.
